lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multi-row horizontal arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, following a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity linear features intersecting horizontal spot rows, visible most clearly in the mid-flank region between the first dorsal fin and the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features exhibiting a vertical luminance gradient of light superior and dark inferior pixels, extending from the branchial area toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparsely distributed high-luminance circular clusters concentrated primarily on the anterior and basal regions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance transverse band-like feature or indentation located at the peduncle base, crossing the leading edge of the superior caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple low-luminance elongated biological features visible in close proximity to the ventral mid-body and pectoral regions, likely representing commensal organisms.
